title: AI Pet Portrait Generator
summary: Free AI pet portrait generator: add your dog or cat's photo and get a royal oil painting, Renaissance noble, watercolour, cartoon or pencil portrait.
body_markdown:
### Is there a free AI pet portrait generator?


Yes. Flick is free to start: the free plan gives 100 credits every day with no credit card, and GPT Image 2.6, which made every portrait on this page from a pet photo, costs 5 credits an image.


### How do I turn my pet into a painting with AI?


Add a clear photo of your pet as a reference image, then describe the painting you want, such as a royal oil portrait on a throne or a loose watercolour, and name the coat colour, markings and eyes the portrait must keep.


### What are the best styles for a pet portrait?


The most popular pet portrait styles are royal and Renaissance oil paintings with costumes, loose watercolour, pencil or charcoal drawings, flat cartoon portraits, pop art screen prints and fantasy or historical roles such as a knight or a naval admiral.


### Can I put my dog and cat in one portrait?


Yes. Add both photos as reference images and describe each pet by its own markings, saying which pet comes from which photo; GPT Image 2.6 takes up to 10 reference images.


### Can I make a memorial portrait of a pet that has died?


Yes. A favourite photo works as the reference, and a soft pencil, charcoal or watercolour portrait with a calm expression and a plain background is a gentle way to remember a pet.


### Can I turn a pet portrait into a video?


Yes. Use the portrait as the start frame of an image to video model in Flick and describe one small movement, such as a slow blink, a twitching ear or flickering candlelight, and ask it to keep the painted look.
